item.title: Greenawalds Chief Andrew Garger and Lower Macungie Captain Joshua Houck
item.description: Greenawalds Chief Andrew Garger and Lower Macungie Captain Joshua Houck pose for a quick photo at a structure fire in Upper Macungie Twp. on January 7, 2026. – Fire News photo by Geoffrey Wetherhold

item.title: 3-Vehicle MVA Rollover with Entrapment
item.description: On January 6, 2026, Station 69 (Lower Burrell) and 56 (New Kensington) were called to a three-vehicle accident, with one vehicle rolled over with an entrapment. Crews quickly cut the roof from a rolled over vehicle to free the driver, who was transported to a local hospital. – Fire News photo by Steve Matto

item.title: Early Morning Basement Fire in Lower Burrell
item.description: Just before 0800 hours on December 24, 2026, Lower Burrell crews and surrounding stations were called to a basement fire in Lower Burrell. Crews arrived quickly and began an attack on the fire. The fire was held to the basement, and firefighters were on scene for roughly 90 minutes. – Fire News photo by Steve […]
